evidence: XRD measurements were performed on ALD MnS thin films grown in the temperature range of 100 −225 °C. MnS thin films with a thickness of 80 −100 nm were grown on fused quartz as well as anodic aluminum oxide (AAO, Whatman Anodisc, Sigma-Aldrich) in order to increase signal-to-noise and break the oriented thin film symmetry (vide infra) thereby revealing more reflections for accurate phase identification. Immediately evident is that even at deposition temperatures as low as 100 °C, ALD MnS thin films are crystalline. In Figure 4 , γ-MnS is the only crystalline phase present at 100 °C (JCPDS #40-1289).
